plugin.name: Wbcom Designs – Shortcodes & Elementor Widgets For BuddyPress

summary: Small, single-purpose plugin: three BuddyPress shortcodes plus three matching Elementor widgets, and an informational admin panel. No settings, no database tables, no REST, no cron, no blocks, no CLI.

ajax.purpose: Paginate the public BuddyPress activity stream for the load-more control.

elementor_widget_detection.note: has_shortcode_on_page() also scans _elementor_data for these widget names, because Elementor pages have empty post_content and has_shortcode() would miss them.

admin_pages.title: WB Plugins
admin_pages.note: Shared Wbcom hub; registered only when absent.

admin_wrapper.not_present: The legacy admin/wbcom/ tab wrapper was removed in 3.0.0. The admin/ directory no longer exists at all.

settings_note: No register_setting(), no update_option() anywhere. Every admin tab is an informational partial with no form and no persisted state.
activation_note: register_activation_hook / register_deactivation_hook and their Activator/Deactivator classes were removed in 3.0.0 - both methods had empty bodies.

buddypress_integration.enabled_when: BuddyPress (or BuddyBoss) active; every bp_is_active() call is function_exists()-guarded
buddypress_integration.template_pack_note: legacy and youzify were removed in 3.0.0. All three shortcodes now resolve to templates/nouveau/ regardless of _bp_theme_package_id; BuddyBoss uses the bb-*.php variants inside that pack.

hooks_fired.pro_contract_note: The bp_shortcode_pro_* filters are the Free/Pro seam consumed by shortcode-for-buddypress-pro. Do not rename or drop without a paired Pro release.

frontend_assets.resolution: bp_shortcode_asset() in includes/functions.php picks rtl/ then min/ then the unminified source, falling back so a missing build never 404s.
frontend_assets.list_columns: loop_layout columns are styled by one rule set in public_css keyed on the plugin's own list class plus the column class BPShortCode::list_classes() puts on the ul (.dir-list ul.bpsp-members-list.grid.two > li, same for bpsp-groups-list). It sets flex-basis and max-width so it beats BuddyBoss Platform's .buddypress-wrap .grid.bp-list > li fixed 33.33% on every theme; the <=479px and 480-598px rules collapse to 1 and 2 columns.

localized_object.name: buddypress_shortcode
localized_object.gate: has_shortcode_on_page() - register, enqueue and localize all run off this single condition so the object always exists wherever the script does.

security.tab_input: $_GET['tab'] read via sanitize_key() then whitelisted against get_tabs()
security.uninstall: uninstall.php present; the plugin stores no options and no tables, so there is nothing to purge

tasks.build: clean, checktextdomain, cssmin, uglify, rtlcss, shell:makepot, copy (bin/build-release.sh zips build/<slug>/ into dist/)

build.pot_generator: wp i18n make-pot via shell:makepot. The grunt-wp-i18n `makepot` task is deliberately NOT used - it produced the stale POT that shipped 714 references to deleted files.

ci.note: GitHub Actions is disabled for this repository, so the .github workflow was removed rather than kept as config that can never run. bin/local-ci.sh is the gate; it exits non-zero on failure. If Actions is re-enabled, restore the workflow from git history (commit a8c295d).

known_gaps: readme.txt 'Tested up to: 7.0' should be re-confirmed before release.
Elementor get_widget_list() and the no-op handleResize() JS were removed in this pass; if a future release needs a resize hook, re-add the listener with the handler, not before.

BuddyBoss-only functions (bb_*, bp_moderation_*, bp_is_*_media_support_enabled, bp_member_type_*) are called unguarded inside the bb-*.php templates and buddypress_shortcode_activity_entry_bubble_buttons. That is safe because both are reached only when buddypress()->buddyboss is set, but any new call site outside those paths needs a function_exists guard.
